CanAgentReachTarget(NavMeshAgent, Vector3, float, ref Vector3)

Determines whether the specified NavMesh agent can reach the given target position within a specified margin.
public static bool CanAgentReachTarget(NavMeshAgent agent, Vector3 target, float margin, ref Vector3 result)

Parameters

agent NavMeshAgent
The NavMeshAgent instance used to calculate the path to the target position. Must be placed on a valid NavMesh.
target Vector3
The world-space position to reach. The method checks if this position is accessible by the agent.
margin float
The maximum distance, in world units, to search for a walkable position near the target. Must be non-negative.
result Vector3
When this method returns, contains the closest walkable position on the NavMesh to the target, if found.

Returns

bool
true if the agent can reach the target position with a complete path; otherwise, false.

Remarks

This method first samples the NavMesh near the target position within the specified margin, then checks if a complete path exists from the agent's current position to the sampled point. If the target is not on the NavMesh or a valid path cannot be found, the method returns false. The result parameter is updated with the closest valid position found on the NavMesh.
